sg-bf157e4638045340.title: Hardcoded credential or API key
sg-bf157e4638045340.description: A string literal assigned to a variable named like a secret (password, api_key, token, secret) appears to be hardcoded in source (CWE-798).
sg-bf157e4638045340.suggestedFix: Move the secret to an environment variable or a secrets manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.) and rotate the exposed credential immediately.

sg-b97e66bd7310614e.title: AWS Access Key ID exposed
sg-b97e66bd7310614e.description: A string matching the AWS Access Key ID format (AKIA...) is present in source (CWE-798).
sg-b97e66bd7310614e.suggestedFix: Revoke this key in the AWS console immediately, then load credentials via environment variables or an IAM role instead of source code.

sg-8bd6bddb7ce0380e.title: Likely hardcoded secret (high entropy)
sg-8bd6bddb7ce0380e.description: The value assigned to `apiKey` has entropy 3.88 bits/char, consistent with a random API key, token, or credential rather than ordinary text (CWE-798).
sg-8bd6bddb7ce0380e.suggestedFix: Move this value to an environment variable or secrets manager, remove it from git history, and rotate the credential.

sg-445d30bba65e050e.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via innerHTML
sg-445d30bba65e050e.description: Untrusted data is assigned to `innerHTML`/`outerHTML` (or React's `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), which can execute attacker-controlled markup/script in the victim's browser (CWE-79).
sg-445d30bba65e050e.suggestedFix: Use `textContent` for plain text, or sanitize HTML with a vetted library (e.g. DOMPurify) before rendering, and avoid `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with unsanitized input.

sg-b1282a5e720333e1.title: Use of eval() / dynamic code execution
sg-b1282a5e720333e1.description: `eval`, `new Function(...)`, or an equivalent dynamic-code-execution construct is used. If any part of the evaluated string is influenced by user input, this is full remote code execution (CWE-95).
sg-b1282a5e720333e1.suggestedFix: Avoid `eval`/dynamic execution entirely; use JSON.parse for data, or an explicit safe interpreter/allow-list for the specific operations needed.

sg-85fe09d50f18b357.title: OS Command Injection
sg-85fe09d50f18b357.description: User-influenced data appears to be passed into a shell command execution function. If the input isn't strictly validated, an attacker can inject additional shell commands (CWE-78).
sg-85fe09d50f18b357.suggestedFix: Avoid shell interpreters entirely: use the argv-array form of process spawning (e.g. `execFile`/`spawn` with an args array, or `subprocess.run([...], shell=False)`), and allow-list input.

sg-22e209fc68114d4d.title: Use of eval() / dynamic code execution
sg-22e209fc68114d4d.description: `eval`, `new Function(...)`, or an equivalent dynamic-code-execution construct is used. If any part of the evaluated string is influenced by user input, this is full remote code execution (CWE-95).
sg-22e209fc68114d4d.suggestedFix: Avoid `eval`/dynamic execution entirely; use JSON.parse for data, or an explicit safe interpreter/allow-list for the specific operations needed.

sg-9a450dd84700b671.title: Use of broken/weak hash algorithm
sg-9a450dd84700b671.description: MD5 or SHA-1 is used, which are cryptographically broken for security purposes (password hashing, integrity, signatures) (CWE-327).
sg-9a450dd84700b671.suggestedFix: Use SHA-256/SHA-3 for integrity checks, and a dedicated password-hashing function (bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2) for credentials — never a general-purpose hash.

sg-eddfd8235c0d11fe.title: Overly permissive CORS configuration
sg-eddfd8235c0d11fe.description: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` is set to `*` (optionally with credentials), allowing any origin to read responses (CWE-942).
sg-eddfd8235c0d11fe.suggestedFix: Return an explicit allow-list of trusted origins instead of `*`, especially when `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true` is also set.

sg-4c42f9e0363ef4dd.title: Insecure deserialization (pickle)
sg-4c42f9e0363ef4dd.description: `pickle.load`/`loads` deserializes arbitrary objects and can execute code if the input is attacker-controlled (CWE-502).
sg-4c42f9e0363ef4dd.owasp: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
sg-4c42f9e0363ef4dd.codeSnippet:
5| # sg-insecure-deserialization-py
6| def load_session(data):
7|     return pickle.loads(data)
8| 
9| # sg-yaml-unsafe-load
sg-4c42f9e0363ef4dd.suggestedFix: Use a safe serialization format (JSON) for untrusted data, or cryptographically sign pickled payloads and verify before loading.

sg-2d3910245f47e438.title: Unsafe YAML deserialization
sg-2d3910245f47e438.description: `yaml.load` without `Loader=SafeLoader` can instantiate arbitrary Python objects from YAML content (CWE-502).

sg-eef01826625e607a.title: Debug mode enabled
sg-eef01826625e607a.description: Framework debug mode is on, which can leak stack traces, source code, and environment variables to end users (CWE-489).
sg-eef01826625e607a.suggestedFix: Disable debug mode in any environment that isn't local development; drive it from an environment variable defaulting to `false`.
